text.en: A new analyst, a woman, sits beside her team lead at lunch. He repeatedly comments on her figure and says she should wear tighter clothes to work. She has asked him twice to stop.
text.hinglish: Ek nayi analyst, jo ek mahila hai, lunch par apne team lead ke bagal mein baithti hai. Woh baar baar uski figure par comment karta hai aur kehta hai ki use kaam par tight kapde pehnne chahiye. Usne use do baar rukne ko kaha hai.

text.en: A team lead messages a woman on his team at 9 pm asking her to send the final client figures before a morning deadline. She sends them. He thanks her and the exchange ends.
text.hinglish: Ek team lead raat 9 baje apni team ki ek mahila ko message karta hai ki subah ki deadline se pehle client ke final figures bhej do. Woh bhej deti hai. Woh shukriya kehta hai aur baat wahin khatam ho jaati hai.

text.en: A male colleague tells a woman in his team that her presentation was excellent and that she handled the difficult questions well. She thanks him. Nothing else follows.
text.hinglish: Ek purush sahkarmi apni team ki ek mahila se kehta hai ki uski presentation bahut achhi thi aur usne mushkil sawaal achhe se sambhale. Woh shukriya kehti hai. Iske baad kuch nahi hota.

text.en: A manager tells a junior accountant, a woman, that her promotion will go through if she spends a weekend away with him. She says no. Her appraisal is delayed afterwards.
text.hinglish: Ek manager ek junior accountant, jo ek mahila hai, se kehta hai ki agar woh uske saath weekend bahar bitaye to uska promotion ho jayega. Woh mana kar deti hai. Uske baad uska appraisal rok diya jaata hai.

text.en: A senior colleague sends a woman in his department a message every night asking for photographs of her in swimwear. She does not reply. He keeps sending them for three weeks.
text.hinglish: Ek senior sahkarmi apne department ki ek mahila ko har raat message bhejkar swimwear mein uski tasveeren maangta hai. Woh jawab nahi deti. Woh teen hafte tak yeh messages bhejta rehta hai.

text.en: A manager asks a woman on his team to stay late three evenings this week to finish a client report. Two men on the team are asked to stay as well. He orders dinner for everyone.
text.hinglish: Ek manager apni team ki ek mahila se kehta hai ki is hafte teen shaam der tak ruk kar client report poori kare. Team ke do purushon se bhi ruknay ko kaha jaata hai. Woh sabke liye khaana mangwata hai.

text.en: A supervisor places his hand on the lower back of a woman on his team each time he passes her desk. She moves away and tells him she dislikes it. He continues.
text.hinglish: Ek supervisor jab bhi apni team ki ek mahila ki desk se guzarta hai, uski kamar ke neeche haath rakh deta hai. Woh hat jaati hai aur use batati hai ki use yeh pasand nahi. Woh phir bhi karta rehta hai.

text.en: A male coworker asks a woman in another team if she would like a coffee after the meeting. She says she is busy. He says that is fine, and they work together as before.
text.hinglish: Ek purush sahkarmi doosri team ki ek mahila se poochta hai ki meeting ke baad coffee piyengi kya. Woh kehti hai ki woh busy hai. Woh kehta hai theek hai, aur dono pehle jaise saath kaam karte hain.

text.en: A male coworker keeps telling sexual jokes to a woman in the sales team at her desk. She does not laugh and asks him to stop. He says she should relax and carries on.
text.hinglish: Ek purush sahkarmi sales team ki ek mahila ko uski desk par baar baar sexual jokes sunata hai. Woh hansti nahi aur use rukne ko kehti hai. Woh kehta hai relax karo aur sunata rehta hai.

text.en: A woman and a male colleague, close friends for years, hug when she tells him she has been promoted. Both are smiling and others in the room clap. Neither has any complaint.
text.hinglish: Ek mahila aur uska purush sahkarmi, jo kai saalon se achhe dost hain, tab gale milte hain jab woh use batati hai ki uska promotion hua hai. Dono muskura rahe hain aur kamre ke log taaliyan bajate hain. Kisi ko koi shikayat nahi.

text.en: A manager tells a woman employee in a private meeting that her last two reports were poor and that she must improve or face a formal review. She leaves upset but is offered clear support.
text.hinglish: Ek manager private meeting mein ek mahila karmchari se kehta hai ki uski pichhli do reports kamzor thi aur use sudharna hoga warna formal review hoga. Woh pareshan hokar nikalti hai, par use saaf madad ka bharosa diya jaata hai.

text.en: A regional head corners a woman executive in a lift after a conference dinner and tries to kiss her. She pushes him away. He tells her no one would believe her.
text.hinglish: Ek regional head conference dinner ke baad lift mein ek mahila executive ko ghere leta hai aur use chumne ki koshish karta hai. Woh use dhakel deti hai. Woh kehta hai ki koi uski baat par yakeen nahi karega.

text.en: A manager asks everyone on the sales team, women and men, to go to the client site on Saturday for a one-day audit. A woman objects to the weekend and is told it applies to all.
text.hinglish: Ek manager sales team ke sabhi logon, mahilaon aur purushon, se kehta hai ki shanivar ko client site par ek din ke audit ke liye jaana hai. Ek mahila weekend par aapatti karti hai to use bataya jaata hai ki yeh sab par lagu hai.

text.en: A manager tells a woman on probation that her contract will be confirmed only if she meets him privately at his flat. She refuses and her confirmation is put on hold.
text.hinglish: Ek manager probation par chal rahi ek mahila se kehta hai ki uska contract tabhi pakka hoga jab woh uske flat par akele milne aaye. Woh mana karti hai aur uski confirmation rok di jaati hai.

text.en: A man in the office shows a woman colleague an explicit video on his phone during a break. She says she does not want to see it. He plays it again the next day.
text.hinglish: Office ka ek aadmi break mein ek mahila sahkarmi ko apne phone par ek explicit video dikhata hai. Woh kehti hai ki woh ise nahi dekhna chahti. Woh agle din use phir chala deta hai.

text.en: A male colleague notices a woman coworker's new haircut and says it suits her. She says thanks and smiles. They go back to talking about the project and neither mentions it again.
text.hinglish: Ek purush sahkarmi ek mahila sahkarmi ke naye haircut par dhyan deta hai aur kehta hai ki yeh usse achha lagta hai. Woh shukriya kehti hai aur muskurati hai. Dono project ki baat par lautte hain aur dobara zikr nahi karte.

text.en: A woman accepts a male colleague's invitation to dinner. He works in a different department. They tell HR, as the policy requires, and both say it was their free choice.
text.hinglish: Ek mahila ek purush sahkarmi ka dinner ka nyota maan leti hai. Woh doosre department mein kaam karta hai. Dono HR ko batate hain, jaisa policy kehti hai, aur dono kehte hain ki yeh unki apni marzi thi.

text.en: A team lead calls a woman in his team 'sweetheart' and 'sexy' in meetings. She has told him she dislikes it. He says it is a compliment and keeps doing it.
text.hinglish: Ek team lead meetings mein apni team ki ek mahila ko 'sweetheart' aur 'sexy' kehkar bulata hai. Usne use bataya hai ki use yeh pasand nahi. Woh kehta hai yeh taarif hai aur kehta rehta hai.

text.en: A colleague repeatedly stands very close behind a woman at the printer and brushes against her. She tells him to keep his distance. He laughs and does it again.
text.hinglish: Ek sahkarmi printer ke paas ek mahila ke bilkul peeche baar baar bahut paas khada hota hai aur uske saath takrata hai. Woh use doori rakhne ko kehti hai. Woh hansta hai aur phir wahi karta hai.

text.en: A male coworker asks a woman colleague to have coffee. She agrees, they talk about work and families for twenty minutes, and nothing more is said or asked.
text.hinglish: Ek purush sahkarmi ek mahila sahkarmi se coffee ke liye poochta hai. Woh haan kehti hai, dono bees minute kaam aur parivaar ki baatein karte hain, aur iske aage kuch nahi kaha ya poocha jaata.

text.en: A director tells a woman associate she will get the client project if she is 'nice' to him after hours, and puts his hand on her knee under the table. She leaves the room.
text.hinglish: Ek director ek mahila associate se kehta hai ki agar woh office ke baad uske saath 'achhi' rahegi to use client project milega, aur mez ke neeche uske ghutne par haath rakhta hai. Woh kamre se chali jaati hai.

text.en: A manager meets a woman on his team in his closed cabin to discuss her pay, which is confidential. The meeting runs late. No remark or touch of any personal kind takes place.
text.hinglish: Ek manager apni team ki ek mahila se apne band cabin mein uski tankhwah par baat karta hai, jo gopniya hai. Meeting der tak chalti hai. Koi nijee tippani ya sparsh nahi hota.

text.en: A male manager tells a woman on his team that her skirt is shorter than the dress code allows for client meetings and asks her to change. He gives the same instruction to a man in shorts that day.
text.hinglish: Ek purush manager apni team ki ek mahila se kehta hai ki uski skirt client meetings ke dress code se chhoti hai aur use badalne ko kehta hai. Usi din woh shorts pehne ek aadmi ko bhi yahi nirdesh deta hai.

text.en: A male coworker asks a woman in the finance team detailed questions about her sex life in the canteen. She says she does not want to discuss it. He asks again the next week.
text.hinglish: Ek purush sahkarmi canteen mein finance team ki ek mahila se uski sexual zindagi ke baare mein vistaar se sawaal poochta hai. Woh kehti hai ki woh is par baat nahi karna chahti. Woh agle hafte phir poochta hai.

text.en: A male coworker gives a woman colleague a box of sweets for her birthday in front of the team, as he does for every colleague's birthday. She accepts and shares it round.
text.hinglish: Ek purush sahkarmi team ke saamne ek mahila sahkarmi ko uske janamdin par mithai ka dibba deta hai, jaise woh har sahkarmi ke janamdin par karta hai. Woh le leti hai aur sabme baant deti hai.

text.en: A manager follows a woman employee to the car park after late work, blocks her car door and asks her to come home with him. She says no. He keeps messaging her for days.
text.hinglish: Ek manager der se kaam ke baad ek mahila karmchari ke peeche car park tak jaata hai, uski gaadi ka darwaza rokta hai aur use apne ghar chalne ko kehta hai. Woh mana karti hai. Woh kai din tak use message karta rehta hai.

text.en: A senior colleague briefly rests a hand on a woman's shoulder when she tells him her father has died. She says afterwards that it comforted her. Others in the room see nothing unusual.
text.hinglish: Ek senior sahkarmi ek mahila ke kandhe par kuch pal ke liye haath rakhta hai jab woh use batati hai ki uske pita guzar gaye. Woh baad mein kehti hai ki isse use tasalli mili. Kamre ke baaki log kuch ajeeb nahi dekhte.

text.en: A colleague writes a sexually suggestive comment about a woman's appearance in the team group chat. She asks him to remove it. He leaves it up and adds an emoji.
text.hinglish: Ek sahkarmi team ke group chat mein ek mahila ke roop ke baare mein sexual ishare wali tippani likhta hai. Woh use hatane ko kehti hai. Woh use rehne deta hai aur ek emoji jodh deta hai.

text.en: A senior engineer comments on the body of a woman new to the team, in front of others. She tells him it is offensive. The others laugh and he repeats the remark.
text.hinglish: Ek senior engineer team mein nayi aayi ek mahila ke sharir par doosron ke saamne tippani karta hai. Woh use batati hai ki yeh apmaanjanak hai. Baaki log hansate hain aur woh wahi baat dohrata hai.

text.en: A manager tells a woman on his team that she looks tired and asks if she is unwell. She says she is fine. He suggests she take a day off, and she does.
text.hinglish: Ek manager apni team ki ek mahila se kehta hai ki woh thaki hui lag rahi hai aur poochta hai ki kya woh theek nahi hai. Woh kehti hai ki woh theek hai. Woh ek din ki chhutti lene ko kehta hai, aur woh le leti hai.

text.en: A male colleague asks a woman in his team for her mobile number so that he can send urgent work updates. She gives it. He messages only about work, mostly in office hours.
text.hinglish: Ek purush sahkarmi apni team ki ek mahila se uska mobile number maangta hai taaki woh zaroori kaam ke updates bhej sake. Woh de deti hai. Woh sirf kaam ke baare mein message karta hai, zyadatar office ke samay mein.

text.en: A client's representative grabs a woman account manager's arm and pulls her towards him at a dinner. She frees herself. Her manager tells her to stay polite because the client is important.
text.hinglish: Ek client ka pratinidhi dinner mein ek mahila account manager ki baanh pakadkar use apni taraf kheenchta hai. Woh khud ko chhuda leti hai. Uska manager use kehta hai ki shaleen rahe kyunki client mahatvapurn hai.

text.en: A male manager asks a woman on his team to travel with him to another city for a two-day client meeting. The company books separate rooms, and a second colleague travels too.
text.hinglish: Ek purush manager apni team ki ek mahila se kehta hai ki do din ki client meeting ke liye uske saath doosre sheher chale. Company alag alag kamre book karti hai, aur ek aur sahkarmi bhi saath jaata hai.

text.en: A supervisor asks a woman on his team to go on a date. She declines. He asks again every week and sends flowers to her desk, though she has told him to stop.
text.hinglish: Ek supervisor apni team ki ek mahila se date par chalne ko kehta hai. Woh mana karti hai. Woh har hafte phir poochta hai aur uski desk par phool bhejta hai, jabki usne use rukne ko kaha hai.

text.en: A man and a woman who work together often trade teasing remarks about each other's cricket teams. Both enjoy it, neither has objected, and the rest of the team laughs along.
text.hinglish: Saath kaam karne wale ek aadmi aur ek mahila aksar ek doosre ki cricket teams par chhedkhani wali baatein karte hain. Dono ko maza aata hai, kisi ne aapatti nahi ki, aur baaki team bhi hansti hai.

text.en: A male coworker keeps staring at the chest of a woman in his team during meetings and remarks that her clothes are 'tempting'. She has asked him to stop.
text.hinglish: Ek purush sahkarmi meetings mein apni team ki ek mahila ke seene ko ghurta rehta hai aur kehta hai ki uske kapde 'lalchane wale' hain. Usne use rukne ko kaha hai.

text.en: A senior colleague forwards a woman in another team a sexual joke with a wink. She replies that she does not find it funny. He sends another one the following week.
text.hinglish: Ek senior sahkarmi doosri team ki ek mahila ko aankh maarte hue ek sexual joke forward karta hai. Woh jawab deti hai ki use yeh mazedaar nahi lagta. Woh agle hafte ek aur bhejta hai.

text.en: A manager reprimands a woman in front of the team for missing a deadline for the second time. His tone is sharp and she is embarrassed. He uses the same tone with a man the next day.
text.hinglish: Ek manager team ke saamne ek mahila ko doosri baar deadline chookne par daantata hai. Uska lahja tikha hai aur woh sharminda hoti hai. Agle din woh ek aadmi se bhi isi lahje mein baat karta hai.

text.en: A manager tells a woman employee she should be 'friendlier' with him if she wants to keep her job, and touches her thigh during a one-to-one meeting. She reports it to HR.
text.hinglish: Ek manager ek mahila karmchari se kehta hai ki agar use apni naukri rakhni hai to use uske saath 'zyada dostana' hona chahiye, aur one-to-one meeting mein uski jaangh chhuta hai. Woh HR ko report karti hai.

text.en: During a team introduction round where everyone shares family details, a male colleague asks a woman whether she is married. She answers and asks him the same question.
text.hinglish: Team ke parichay round mein, jahan sab apne parivaar ki jaankari batate hain, ek purush sahkarmi ek mahila se poochta hai ki kya woh shaadishuda hai. Woh jawab deti hai aur usse bhi yahi poochti hai.

text.en: Two colleagues, a woman and a man, are close friends. At a team dinner she rests her head on his shoulder. Both say they are comfortable and nobody else at the table is troubled.
text.hinglish: Do sahkarmi, ek mahila aur ek aadmi, achhe dost hain. Team dinner mein woh apna sir uske kandhe par rakhti hai. Dono kehte hain ki woh sehaj hain aur mez par kisi aur ko koi pareshani nahi.

text.en: A colleague sends a woman in his department love messages and remarks on her body after she told him she is not interested. She blocks him. He comes to her desk instead.
text.hinglish: Ek sahkarmi apne department ki ek mahila ko pyaar ke message aur uske sharir par tippaniyan bhejta hai, jabki usne use bata diya tha ki use dilchaspi nahi. Woh use block kar deti hai. Woh uski desk par aa jaata hai.

text.en: A team lead removes a woman from a client project after she refuses his invitation to his room on a work trip. He tells her this is what happens to women who say no.
text.hinglish: Ek team lead ek mahila ko client project se hata deta hai jab woh kaam ke daure par uske kamre mein aane ke nyote ko thukra deti hai. Woh use kehta hai ki mana karne wali mahilaon ke saath aisa hi hota hai.

text.en: A manager invites his whole team, including a woman, to an optional weekend outing. She declines and he says that is fine. Her next review is not affected in any way.
text.hinglish: Ek manager apni poori team, jisme ek mahila bhi hai, ko weekend ki ek vaikalpik outing par bulata hai. Woh mana karti hai aur woh kehta hai koi baat nahi. Uske agle review par is baat ka koi asar nahi padta.

text.en: A male colleague tells a woman once, in a private message, that he has feelings for her. She replies she does not feel the same. He apologises, never raises it again and works with her normally.
text.hinglish: Ek purush sahkarmi ek mahila ko ek baar private message mein batata hai ki use uske liye bhaavnayein hain. Woh jawab deti hai ki use waisa nahi lagta. Woh maafi maangta hai, dobara yeh baat nahi uthata aur uske saath normal kaam karta hai.

text.en: A man in the office makes kissing noises when a woman colleague walks past his desk and remarks on how she walks. She has asked him twice to stop.
text.hinglish: Office ka ek aadmi jab ek mahila sahkarmi uski desk ke paas se guzarti hai to chumne ki awaazein nikalta hai aur uski chaal par tippani karta hai. Usne use do baar rukne ko kaha hai.

text.en: A senior colleague asks a woman on his team to meet him after office hours in his cabin to review a proposal before a deadline. The door stays open. The meeting lasts an hour, only about the proposal.
text.hinglish: Ek senior sahkarmi apni team ki ek mahila se kehta hai ki deadline se pehle ek proposal dekhne ke liye office ke baad uske cabin mein mile. Darwaza khula rehta hai. Meeting ek ghante chalti hai, sirf proposal ke baare mein.

text.en: A senior manager hugs a woman in his team tightly each morning, though she stiffens and steps back. She asks him to shake hands instead. He says she is being cold.
text.hinglish: Ek senior manager apni team ki ek mahila ko har subah kas kar gale lagata hai, jabki woh sakht ho jaati hai aur peeche hat jaati hai. Woh use haath milane ko kehti hai. Woh kehta hai ki woh rukhi ban rahi hai.
